title: AI Agent Security demo: threat profile + threat rule (+ optional content moderation)

steps.describe: Host object {client_host_name} ({client_ip}) so the demo only affects this computer

payload.name: {client_host_name}
payload.comments: Created by AI Guard Demo Kit

conflict_fix: Rename or delete the existing host {client_host_name} in SmartConsole (Objects > Object Explorer)
Or limit the rule to another object: --scope <object name> (or --scope any)
manual_steps: SmartConsole > Objects > New > Host: name {client_host_name}, IPv4 address {client_ip}, comment "Created by AI Guard Demo Kit"

steps.describe: Threat profile {profile_name} with AI Agent Security on (project {lakera_project_id})

payload.name: {profile_name}
payload.comments: Created by AI Guard Demo Kit

conflict_fix: Choose another name: --profile-name <name> (web console: Profile name)
Or rename the existing profile {profile_name} in SmartConsole
manual_steps: SmartConsole > Security Policies > Threat Prevention > Profiles > New: name {profile_name}, comment "Created by AI Guard Demo Kit"
In the profile turn on AI Agent Security, enter the Guard API key and the project ID {lakera_project_id}

steps.describe: Threat rule "{rule_name}" at the top of {threat_layer}, scope {protected_scope}

payload.name: {rule_name}
payload.comments: Created by AI Guard Demo Kit

conflict_fix: Choose another name: --rule-name <name> (web console: Rule name)
Or rename the existing rule "{rule_name}" in {threat_layer} (SmartConsole > Security Policies > Threat Prevention)
manual_steps: SmartConsole > Security Policies > Threat Prevention > {threat_layer}: add a rule at the top named "{rule_name}"
Protected Scope {protected_scope}, Action {profile_name}, Track {track}, Install On {gateway}, comment "Created by AI Guard Demo Kit"

steps.describe: Install the Threat Prevention policy of {package} on {gateway}
Turn on content moderation on {gateway} (gateway setting, not in the Management API)

payload.script-name: AI Guard Demo Kit: enable content moderation
payload.script: confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv4.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v true && confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv6.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v true

payload.script-name: AI Guard Demo Kit: disable content moderation
payload.script: confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv4.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v false && confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv6.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v false

manual_steps: On each gateway member in Expert mode run: confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv4.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v false
On each gateway member in Expert mode run: confp_cli set -p firewall.ipv4.prompt_injection.prompt_injection_moderated_content_enable -v true
